subject: literacy
concept: Comparing how two authors present conflicting information on the same topic
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts claims from two conflicting texts into a comparison chart, noting where they disagree
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a specific disagreement point to the evidence each author uses to support their side
exercise.abstract: Student writes a paragraph analyzing where and why two texts on the same topic disagree

assessment.mastery_threshold: identifies a genuine point of disagreement and the evidence each side offers, without declaring one side 'right' without justification
misconception_flags: sides with one text without evaluating the actual evidence each side presents

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
